additional_info.subject: ID0470964-DC/Si-D/DE-[Y2/S5 313661877001] Connector 2 issue CRM:03056000896
additional_info.body:
Dear Nils,
Thank you for contacting our eMobility Support.
Following a review of the information provided and a deeper system check on charger Y2 / S5 313651774001
, we can confirm that the issue is not due to the charging station itself. As show in the attached logs, the charging station is ready do delivery up to 300 kW, but the truck is requesting 0 kW. This could be due to a network connection issue or ho the cables were connected.
We will continue to monitor the charger for the next few days. Should the error recur, we will take the necessary action to resolve it. Otherwise, we will proceed to close the ticket.
Best regards,
Ivan
Siemens eMobility Technical Support Team
